= Schedulers (In-Process)

Libraries for scheduling recurring in-process tasks using cron-like syntax in
Node.js.

* https://github.com/merencia/node-cron[merencia/node-cron]
* https://github.com/kelektiv/node-cron[kelektiv/node-cron]
* https://github.com/node-schedule/node-schedule[Node Schedule]
* https://github.com/P4sca1/cron-schedule[cron-schedule]
